name: StandWithUkraine
description: displays a message and styles to show support for Ukraine.
project_description:
🇺🇦 
 
 This module is maintained by Ukrainian developers. 
Please consider supporting Ukraine in a fight for their freedom and safety of Europe. 
 
 
 
 The module provides a few features to show your support for Ukrainians.

 Features 
 
 Message on the background of the flag which can be attached to one of the three sides of the page (top, right, left). 
 Painting the favicon and images from blocks in the colors of the Ukraine flag. 
 A block contains a message provided by the first feature. 
 
 Additional Requirements 
 
 Elphin IcoFileLoader library. 
 Service module. 
 
 Similar projects 
 
 Stand With Ukraine displays a banner on your site to show your support for Ukraine.
